notes: HAND-ASSEMBLED. The two Fix12-by-value Render overloads cannot be member definitions (the by-value-class wall, documented in include/OAM.h): the 7-arg one stays an extern "C" def and the 10-arg one is compiled under `#pragma cplusplus off` inside the TU -- its shard was a `.c` file and only the C front end reproduces the frame (+8 bytes of locals under C++).

`#pragma defer_codegen off` is load-bearing and the file lists members ROM-ascending: deferred codegen reads optimization pragmas last-wins at end of file, which leaked LoadAffineParams' trailing offs backward onto the 10-arg Render (0x688 vs 0x690). With parse-time codegen each pragma bracket applies where written and emission order is source order.

Four local decompositions of the 8-byte attribute entry survive under unique names: OamAttrEntry (Render's hardware-entry bitfields), OamAttrTpl (the 7-arg Render's template bitfields), OamAttrRaw/OamEntryRaw (the 10-arg Render's a01/a2/a3 word view), OAMEntry (Reset's a/b pair). Shared OamAttr stays the parameter type on every member signature; each body binds its view in one cast.
include/OAM.h gained `static void Reset();` -- the only member the header lacked (the shard had dodged it with `namespace OAM`, which cannot coexist with `struct OAM` in one TU).
